messages:
maria: Short follow-up: after the RFC feedback, we should pick a default for cross-project service calls. Two options: (A) direct grants (explicit cross-project ACLs) or (B) delegation via proxy-issued ephemeral tokens. Pros/cons?
kevin: My vote is B for security (least blast radius). But for high-frequency low-latency paths we should allow cached direct grants. Need admin approval for direct grants.
nora: +1 on delegation. UX note: console needs to show "delegation audit" entries and surface who approved direct grants. Also TTL defaults should be short (<=5m) for delegated tokens.
infra-bot: infra: created AUTH-3301 to add delegation audit events and TTL enforcement.
maria: Proposed decision: default to delegation (proxy mints ephemeral act_as token), allow direct grants for high-throughput flows behind explicit admin approval and quota. Migration: default new services to delegation.
kevin: Add runbook: if delegation failures spike, fall back to read-only direct grant with manual approval. Add monitoring alert for delegation error rate.
nora: I'll mock the console banner and audit view. Maria pls put decision in DECISION-1724 and link AUTH-3301.
maria: Will do. Closing for now :+1:
